detail.description:
[YEP: Raising Feet UP]
A young life form named 'Yep' lives on a planet similar to Earth. 
On this planet, to become an adult life form called 'Feet', one must pass a special test. 
The goal is to conquer space! Explore unfamiliar planets and test limits.
The young 'Yep' sets out on an adventure with a capsule specially made on his home planet. 
Can he really become 'Feet'?

[Open the Capsule and Get Equipment!]
Bang! Bang! Bang! Acquire equipment with the special capsule brought from home planet
